aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description: UTN student and fullstack builder who enjoys developing on Fedora Linux and prefers clean abstractions over bloated frameworks.

items.content: Fullstack Engineering. I work with React, Next.js, Node.js, and FastAPI. I build complete products from initial DB schema to frontend deployment, keeping the architecture straightforward.
Real-World AI. AI shouldn't be a wrapper. I write APIs that connect LLMs to structured data and local agentic workflows, using prompt engineering and serverless backends to solve tangible problems.
Linux & Tooling. I develop on Fedora Linux because a local, tailored environment speeds up my feedback loop. I value clean git history, automated tests, and terminal-centric workflows.

content.title: About
content.subtitle: I write code that works, build on Fedora Linux, and automate whatever I can.
content.bio: I'm a Fullstack AI Developer and UTN student based in Argentina. I don't believe in adding dependencies for things that can be solved with a few lines of clean code, nor do I believe in AI wrappers that just forward user messages. I build products end-to-end, linking frontend state to robust FastAPI backends.
content.details: If you want a developer who spent hours configuring their system to match their exact workflow, understands why bad abstractions fail under load, and treats LLMs as standard tools rather than magic, let's talk.
